# Generated from sheets/*.json by tools/gen.py. Do not edit; change the sheet.
# Landing Rights: stake a claim on a planet, then build on it in Dyson Sphere Program.

mission "Landing Rights: claim New Boston"
	landing
	invisible
	repeat
	source "New Boston"
	to offer
		has "landing rights: engine"
		not "landing rights: claim New Boston"
	on offer
		conversation
			`A surveyor in a mud-spattered coat waves a land deed at you. "Marsh plot out past the textile mills. Nobody wants it. Five thousand and it's yours, mineral rights included."`
			choice
				`	"I'll take it." (Pay 5,000 credits.)`
				`	"Maybe another time."`
					decline
			branch "can pay"
				"credits" >= 5000
			`	You check your account. You don't have enough credits, and the deed goes back into the coat.`
				decline
			label "can pay"
			action
				payment -5000
				set "landing rights: claim New Boston"
			`	The deed is yours: an ocean world plot on New Boston. Your engineering mecha is already heading down to the surface. (Landing Rights: build in Dyson Sphere Program, click "Ship to Endless Sky" on a Depot there, fill it, and press F8 to ship them up to your fleet. Back here, press F at any time to go down to the surface again.)`
				decline
